title: Deep-V Tiered Ruffle Tulle Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Deep-V Tiered Ruffle Tulle Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Deep-V sleeveless maternity photoshoot gown with a wide waistband and a full skirt of tiered ruffle tulle. 6 colors, US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a sleeveless gown with a plunging V-neck, a wide waistband, and a big ball-gown skirt of ruffle tulle tiers from waist to floor that moves beautifully when you walk or twirl.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
sleeveless deep V-neck bodice with a pleated look, a wide waistband, and a full ball-gown skirt of many layered tulle ruffle tiers falling to the floor.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Dusty Blue, Champagne Gold, White, Black, Blush Pink and Burgundy.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust and by the widest part of your bump at the waistband, and size up if you are between sizes. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
garment_lock: a sleeveless ball gown with a plunging deep V-neck bodice on wide shoulder straps, a wide fitted waistband, and a very full floor-length skirt made of many layers of gathered ruffle tulle tiers, with a slight sweep at the hem

image_prompt:
DRESS LIKE MOMMY — RELIABLE PHOTOSHOOT SYSTEM (automated run)

The attached images are the exact reference for ONE Shopify listing: a maternity photoshoot gown, "Deep-V Tiered Ruffle Tulle Maternity Photoshoot Gown", in DUSTY BLUE (a soft dusty blue, grey-blue).
The gown (ref1 full length, ref2 and ref3 the same gown): a sleeveless ball gown with a plunging deep V-neck bodice on wide shoulder straps, a wide fitted waistband, and a very full floor-length skirt made of many layers of gathered ruffle tulle tiers, with a slight sweep at the hem. The skirt tiers are narrow, even rows of ruffled tulle starting just below the waistband and stacking all the way to the hem.

Generate FOUR separate images in this order and save each into the current working directory with exactly these names:
- image1.png — IMAGE 1, MAIN HERO: a visibly pregnant woman (about 7 months) standing in a bright, softly lit photo studio with a plain light backdrop, wearing this gown, one hand on her bump, the other holding the skirt out so the ruffle tiers show; full length, front-facing, gown in sharp focus.
- image3.png — IMAGE 3, BEST OCCASION: the same woman at an outdoor maternity photoshoot in a meadow at golden hour, the tiered tulle skirt moving in the breeze; full length.
- image5.png — IMAGE 5, PRODUCT-ONLY: no people. The gown displayed on a white dress form (mannequin) in a bright studio, skirt spread around the base, showing the deep V-neck, the waistband and the many ruffle tiers clearly.
- image6.png — IMAGE 6, ALTERNATE LIFESTYLE: the same pregnant woman on a beach at sunset with her partner (a man in a plain white shirt and beige trousers) standing behind her with his hands on her bump; she wears the gown; three-quarter length.
Do not ask me anything; continue until all four files are saved. Keep the same woman across images 1, 3 and 6.

Each output: one single vertical 9:16 photo, no collage, no borders, no text, no watermark. Crop minimally to 9:16 if needed.
PRODUCT LOCK: dusty blue colour, sleeveless deep V-neck, wide waistband, very full floor-length ball-gown skirt of many layered ruffle tulle tiers. No sleeves, no belt, no sequins. No logos, no letters, no extra embellishment.
MODEL STYLE: a natural-looking European woman, fair to light-medium skin, warm smile, tasteful and elegant; a different woman from the reference photos.
STRICT QUALITY CHECK before saving: reject and regenerate if the gown design or colour changed, the deep V-neck or the ruffle tiers are missing, she does not look pregnant, extra text appears, it is a collage, not 9:16, or it looks fake.
When all four files are saved, reply with one line per file: name, width x height.
